paite: Pathian aw, hon humbit in, nangmah ah ka ginna ka koih hi.
heading: David La / Ngaihmuanna Thumna
english: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah, nang tuh ka TOUPA na hi a; nang lou ngal thil hoih himhim ka nei kei.
english: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

paite: Lei a misiangthou omte zaw, amau zaw mihoih, ka kipahna teng omna ahi uh, ka chi ahi.
english: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

paite: pathian dangte kiang a taite zaw, alungkhamnate uh apung ding, asisan dawn kithoihna uh ke'n zaw ka lan kei ding a, ka muk in aminte uh ka lou sam kei ding hi.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

paite: TOUPA ka goutan leh ka nou tan ahi, nang ka tantuam na hon hihkipsak zel hi.
english: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

paite: Tehna khaute mun nuamtak ah ka tuam ding in aketa ahi; ahi, gou hoihtak ka luahta ahi.
english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

paite: TOUPA, suangtuahsakpa, ka phat ding a, ahi, zan chiang in ka lungsim hon hilhpil zel hi.
english: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

paite: TOUPA ka ma ah ka omsak gige a; ka taklam a a-om ziak in ka ling kei ding hi.
english: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lungtang akipak a, ka thupina anuam hi; ka sa leng bittak in a-om ding hi.
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

paite: Ka kha Sheol ah na nuse kei ding a, muatna mu ding in na misiangthou na phal sam kei ding hi.
english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

paite: Nang hinna lampi na hon theisak ding a; na ma ah nuam dimletna a-om hi; na khut taklam ah tangtawn kipahna ding a-om hi.
english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
